description: Carmine No.7 is a fictional ink house: a Zyqor Studio design concept built with Video Flow, a scroll-scrubbed real-footage page (one drop of red ink blooming in water).

hero.title: Carmine
hero.sub: One drop of No.7 in clear water. Keep scrolling and watch it take over the glass.

beats.title: One drop / is enough
beats.body: No.7 is milled three times, so a single drop blooms through the water instead of sinking like a stone.

beats.title: Saturated / on purpose
beats.body: Dense enough to stay red on cheap copy paper. Clean enough that it never clogs a nib.

beats.title: It moves / like silk
beats.body: Watch the edges: soft, slow, unhurried. That is the flow you feel under the pen.

beats.title: Dry in / nine seconds
beats.body: A satin finish that sets fast enough for left-handers and keeps a hint of sheen when it catches the light.

specs.title: Made to be / written with
specs.body: Every number below is a spec of the concept ink, not a claim about a real product. The page around it is generated from one config file and one video.

items.label: milled, for a bloom and not a blot

strip.title: One shot. / {frames} frames.
strip.body: The bloom is real footage, cut into {frames} webp frames and drawn to a canvas as you scroll. Tap any frame to scrub back to it.

cta.title: Put some / red on it
cta.body: A concept bottle for a fictional ink house. Nothing is for sale; the red is real.
cta.note: Zyqor Lab concept. Fictional brand, real footage.
